eventSearchResults.title: African American Leadership Conference 2025-2027
eventSearchResults.description:
About AALC

The African American Leadership Conference is a Bridges: Colloquia for Cultivating Ministry (Bridges) program.

Bridges programming serves to bring pastors who are more seasoned and who have excelled in ministry together with emerging pastors and those transitioning and ministry.  The goal of this program is to foster higher levels of well-being for pastors, which will help pastors be healthier, more creative, innovative, higher performing, and more adaptable and resilient church leaders. 

Among the expected outcomes are a better sense of connection among these pastors with one another (addressing the challenges of isolation and the pastorate) increased knowledge around financial wellness and literacy, and assistance with the challenges of church leadership and management. MMBB's intent with these colloquia is to create community among pastoral leaders and a safe space to develop trust and encourage a deeper sense of commitment and wellness during ministry that will enhance the pastors understanding of their meaning and purpose in life and their future and ministry.
